blackbox has a question:
The CRM source tracking system has been implemented and is now working. Here's what's in place:

What was already working:

UTM parameter capture (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, etc.)
User behavior tracking (page views, clicks, form submits)
Backend models with socialPlatform field
Admin dashboard with source analytics
What I enhanced:

Updated the frontend userBehaviorService to automatically detect the social platform (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Google, etc.) from UTM parameters and referrer
Added socialPlatform field to be saved in the database
Fixed bugs in AdminCRMDashboard (missing List imports) and Pooja page (null check for title)
How it works:

When a user visits with a link like yoursite.com?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social, the system captures:

utm_source = "instagram"
social_platform = "instagram"
All page views and interactions are tracked with this source
In the Admin Dashboard at /admin-crm, you can see:

Sessions by Social Media Source
Conversions by Source
Contacts by Source
User Journey for any session
To test:
Share a link with UTM parameters like:
http://localhost:3000/?utm_source=instagram&utm_campaign=promo

Then check the admin dashboard to see the analytics.

Is the CRM system working as expected now?
